topic: Someone receives flowers with no card attached
text: I found them on my doorstep this morning, a bouquet of roses, vibrant and red, with no note to tell me who sent them. I stood there, the hallway light still on behind me, holding these flowers that smelled of secrets. Who could have left them? The questions swirled, but the answers were as elusive as the morning mist. My hands trembled slightly as I arranged them in a vase, each stem a silent whisper of intent. I scanned my memory for any clue, any hint of a gesture or a word that might explain this. The phone remained stubbornly silent, offering no clues, no relief. I couldn’t shake the sense that these roses held a message, but it was one I was still far from deciphering.
